column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- ipl: the GRAPHICS PROGRAMS of the Icon Program Library, out of the published denominator, one row per unit:
# name<TAB>NEEDS_GRAPHICS_FACILITY<TAB>evidence. LON'S WORD, 2026-09-27, in-chat to hq_icon, verbatim: "Place the graphics programs on the exclude list."
# THE TEST, MEASURED NOT READ: a unit is a graphics program when its own source or its link closure (procs/, gprocs/) calls a graphics
# built-in -- the 48 names the function() of an iconx 9.5.25a built with X-Configure lists beyond the installed NoGraphics oracle's
# (Active Alert Bg Clip Clone Color ColorValue CopyArea ... WAttrib WDefault WFlush WriteImage WSync) -- or opens a window. A unit
# that only links a graphics library and runs without reaching it stays in the denominator as fixture work: the seven procs/ variant
# translator skeletons that UNGRADABLE.tsv had filed with the graphics rows run under the NoGraphics oracle and fail on Mp/init/program
# (supplied by generated code), so they are UNGRADED NEEDS_DRIVER, not excluded. An excluded unit is still shipped and still sits in its
# UNGRADABLE bucket (ORACLE_CONTRACT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED); the row reads pass / (shipped - containers - excluded) with Excl named.
# 182 rows (measured 2026-09-27 on corpus with the classifier in hq_icon's scratch; re-derive, never trust this count).
